hints: Focus on what isomer really means here, same molecular formula, not just similar names or functional groups.
Count the total carbons in each name first, the longest chain plus any methyl branches or alkyl groups.
Remember that a ketone and an aldehyde can be isomers if they share the same $C_xH_yO$ formula, so check which pair matches in both C and H count.
walkthrough:
**Recall the test for isomers**

Isomers must have exactly the same molecular formula but different structural arrangement. So we just need to work out the formula for each pair.

Rule:
$$\text{isomers} \Rightarrow \text{same numbers of C, H and O}$$

**Count carbons from the names**

This is the fastest filter. Add the parent chain plus branches.

$2,2\text{-dimethylpropanoic acid}$ = 3 + 2 = $C_5$, but $\text{propyl methanoate}$ = 1 + 3 = $C_4$. $2\text{-methylbutan-2-ol}$ = 4 + 1 = $C_5$, but $\text{hexan-3-ol}$ = $C_6$. $3,3\text{-dimethylbutan-2-one}$ = 4 + 2 = $C_6$, but $\text{pentan-3-one}$ = $C_5$.

**Check the remaining pair**

$3\text{-methylbutan-2-one}$ = 4 + 1 = $C_5$ ketone, formula $C_5H_{10}O$. $\text{Pentanal}$ = $C_5$ aldehyde, formula $C_5H_{10}O$.

Both have:
$$C_5H_{10}O$$

**Conclude**

Only this pair shares the same molecular formula with different functional groups, a ketone versus an aldehyde. That is a classic functional group isomerism, so this statement is correct.

options.A: Incorrect. 2,2-dimethylpropanoic acid is $(CH_3)_3C-COOH$ with formula $C_5H_{10}O_2$, while propyl methanoate is $HCO_2CH_2CH_2CH_3$ with formula $C_4H_8O_2$. Different carbon counts, so they cannot be isomers.
options.B: Incorrect. 2-methylbutan-2-ol has 5 carbons in total, formula $C_5H_{12}O$, while hexan-3-ol has 6 carbons, formula $C_6H_{14}O$. Students who miss the extra carbon in hexane often pick this.
options.C: Correct. 3-methylbutan-2-one is a $C_5$ ketone, $CH_3COCH(CH_3)_2$, formula $C_5H_{10}O$. Pentanal is a $C_5$ aldehyde, $CH_3CH_2CH_2CH_2CHO$, also $C_5H_{10}O$. Same formula, different structure and functional group, so they are isomers.
options.D: Incorrect. 3,3-dimethylbutan-2-one has 4 + 2 = 6 carbons, formula $C_6H_{12}O$, while pentan-3-one has 5 carbons, formula $C_5H_{10}O$. The two methyl branches are easy to overlook.
